title: Restaurant with bar, interior renovation — San Juan, pin dropped in the water (harbor)
description: We are opening a restaurant with a bar in Old San Juan in a leased space and will renovate the interior and kitchen. We will serve rum cocktails.

mustInclude.rationale: RULE_0002 municipality baseline: every business gets the IRS EIN. (KB: RULE_0002, RULE_0620)
RULE_0003 municipality baseline: Registro de Comerciante (SURI). (KB: RULE_0003)
RULE_0651: new LLC -> Certificate of Organization (Departamento de Estado). (KB: RULE_0651)
RULE_0004 municipality baseline: Patente Municipal (Ley 107-2020 Codigo Municipal). (KB: RULE_0004)
RULE_0007: a physical commercial premises (Q_PHYSICAL_LOCATION) -> Permiso Unico (Ley 161-2009). (KB: RULE_0007)
RULE_0643/0644: project_type new_construction / renovation -> OGPe construction permit (Ley 161-2009). (KB: RULE_0643)
RULE_0009 (Q_FOOD_PREPARED) + business-type rule: food service -> Licencia Sanitaria (Salud). (KB: RULE_0009, RULE_0046)
RULE_0011 (Q_FOOD_PREPARED) + business-type rule: Certificado de Prevencion de Incendios (Bomberos). (KB: RULE_0011, RULE_0047)
RULE_0010: food prepared on site -> Certified Food Protection Manager. (KB: RULE_0010, RULE_0048)
RULE_0013/0014: alcohol sold/served -> Hacienda alcoholic-beverage license. (KB: RULE_0013, RULE_0014)
RULE_0621: alcohol license prerequisite (CRIM debt certification). (KB: RULE_0621, RULE_0622)
RULE_0624: alcohol license prerequisite (ASUME certification). (KB: RULE_0624, RULE_0625)
RULE_0627: alcohol license prerequisite (good-conduct certificate). (KB: RULE_0627, RULE_0628)

San Juan is an autonomous municipality with its own Oficina de Permisos (delegated jerarquia under the Codigo Municipal, Ley 107-2020): the construction permit may be issued by the municipality, so the card should name it (or 'OGPe / Municipio'). Expert: confirm San Juan's current delegation level.

mustNotInclude.rationale: Pin is in a water body (JP AGUA / CRIM TIPO A): off-lot, zoning/land-class facts are withheld and AGUA is not a conservation district (zoningFamily -> 'water').

A pin in the harbor is not the business's lot: flood facts from an off-lot water pin should prompt the user to move the pin rather than produce a REQUIRED Reg. 13 card (layers.ts keeps flood/coastal facts for off-lot pins).
Same: an off-lot water pin should not yield a REQUIRED coastal review for an interior renovation.

No renewable installation: RULE_0611 needs Q_RENEWABLE_INSTALL=true.
No microgrid stated: PT_MICROGRID needs microgrid_configuration=true; energy.test.ts: 'a rooftop system is not assumed to be a microgrid'.
